description: Create a Shopify-owned cart after buyer confirmation of live variants and quantities. Retain cart_access_token for get_cart/update_cart. For an agent-authorized purchase, use the returned agent_checkout route in the buyer's separate Shop MCP connection; Shop handles sign-in, approval, and payment. Otherwise use Commonlands create_checkout for a customer payment link. This tool places no order.

meta.description: Optional UCP metadata. ucp-agent.profile is filled from server config when omitted.

name: create_cart
title: Create Shopify cart
